    What your clients see

    Capture

    First capture? See the steps
    1. Install Veylet Capture on a LiDAR iPhone and sign in with this same email. App access and the supported transfer route are arranged with Veylet support.
    2. Do one practice capture in a space you are allowed to record. The app shows the moves that matter and route checks. An automatic quality check assesses capture quality before confirming the next step.
    3. Save the space here — suburb or city only, no street address — then capture it on the approved route.
    4. Open the saved capture and choose Export capture. Save the ZIP to Files or AirDrop to your Mac, then use the private transfer route agreed with Veylet support. Exporting does not send it. Direct sending from the app and public website import are not available in the current release; the finished walkthrough appears in this space.
    5. Review the walkthrough here, confirm its permissions, then press Approve and share. Anyone with its link can view or forward it.

    Finishing, exporting or leaving
    When a tour is finished
    Turn off its sharing under Manage sharing. New visitors are blocked at once; remove the link or embed from your listing too. Copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled.
    What stays
    Your spaces, walkthroughs and review history stay on this account until you ask for removal. A shared walkthrough stays hosted while your plan is active, and for at least twelve months from its release whatever happens to the plan; its card shows the date.
    What you can take
    A file listing your spaces and tours. It holds no link secrets, imagery or scene files. Ask Veylet support about a full export of a delivered tour.
    Deleting your account

    Deleting your account cannot recall downloaded copies. Turn off sharing on live walkthroughs first. What is kept afterwards, and for how long, is in the terms.
